title: Au nanoparticles with oxygen vacancies on BiVO4 for electrocatalytic nitrate reduction to ammonia
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14739-14744
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00886G, Paper

Kui Hu, Shengbo Zhang, Zhixian Mao, Dongnan Zhao, Daopeng Li, Zhongjun Li, Qiang Li, Qiong Tang, Tongfei Shi
It is demonstrated that by using Au nanoparticles embedded on BiVO4 with oxygen vacancies, the electrocatalytic NitRR is indeed possible under ambient conditions.
